title: Typewriter Font 32x
description: Typewriter like font that also supports accented and nonlatin-european letters.
body:
'Typewriter Font' is a Minecraft Resource Pack that aims to recreate typewriter like letters. It makes the Gameplay feel more medieval and immersive.
## The Alphabet
![Typewriter Font Alphabet](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/3f107c4c156dc2231cb7d1a7c462c8cc94abc4ab.png)
## Also supports cyrillic/accented letters and pictograms
![cyrillic](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f1eb0f31d941092aecaa5df1ec324584c46786f4.png)
